canonical_name: Recovered Chirality Seed / Byte Probe Basis
definition: The Live Landscape probe basis is corrected: use two mirror chirality orientations (seed/byte) crossed, when useful, with six basin occupancy levels. Do not treat 1/7..6/7 as six byte identities.
math: Seed_L=[[1,0],[0,1]], Seed_R=[[0,1],[1,0]] under 1={empty set},0=empty set; Byte_L=(Seed_L,Seed_R), Byte_R=(Seed_R,Seed_L); basin beta_k=k/7, k=1..6.
